text: 工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红在2026中国算力大会上表示，算力已成为数据时代不可或缺的新型信息基础设施。“十五五”规划纲要明确提出，构建多层次算力设施体系和全国一体化算力网。
text_en: Zhong Zhihong, Chief Engineer of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said at the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that computing power has become an indispensable new type of information infrastructure in the data era. The outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly proposes building a multi-level computing power facility system and a nationwide integrated computing power network.
